#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

class Graph {
private:
    int vNum;
    int src;
    int sink;
    
    vector<vector<int>> res;
    vector<vector<int>> cost;
    vector<vector<pair<int, int>>> adj;
    vector<int> d;
    vector<int> p;
    
    struct Edge {
        int from;
        int to;
        int cost;
        Edge(int f, int t, int c) : from(f), to(t), cost(c) {}
    };
    
public:
    Graph(int vNum, int src, int sink) : vNum(vNum), src(src), sink(sink) {
        res = vector<vector<int>>(vNum, vector<int>(vNum, 0));
        cost = vector<vector<int>>(vNum, vector<int>(vNum, 0));
        adj = vector<vector<pair<int, int>>>(vNum);
        d = vector<int>(vNum, INT_MAX);
        p = vector<int>(vNum, -1);
    }
    
    void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity, int costVal) {
        res[from][to] += capacity;
        this->cost[from][to] = costVal;
        this->cost[to][from] = -costVal;
        adj[from].push_back({to, costVal});
        adj[to].push_back({from, -costVal});
    }
    
    bool findCheapestPath() {
        d.assign(vNum, INT_MAX);
        p.assign(vNum, -1);
        d[src] = 0;
        
        bool changed = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < vNum - 1; ++i) {
            changed = false;
            for (int u = 0; u < vNum; ++u) {
                if (d[u] == INT_MAX) continue;
                for (auto& edge : adj[u]) {
                    int v = edge.first;
                    int c = edge.second;
                    if (res[u][v] > 0 && d[u] + c < d[v]) {
                        d[v] = d[u] + c;
                        p[v] = u;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!changed) break;
        }
        
        return p[sink] != -1;
    }
    
    vector<int> augmentPath(int from, int to, int flow) {
        int pathCost = 0;
        int minFlow = flow;
        for (int cur = to; cur != from; cur = p[cur]) {
            minFlow = min(minFlow, res[p[cur]][cur]);
        }
        for (int cur = to; cur != from; cur = p[cur]) {
            res[p[cur]][cur] -= minFlow;
            res[cur][p[cur]] += minFlow;
            pathCost += cost[p[cur]][cur] * minFlow;
        }
        return {minFlow, pathCost};
    }
    
    vector<int> getMinCostMaxFlow() {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        int totalCost = 0;
        while (findCheapestPath()) {
            vector<int> result = augmentPath(src, sink, INT_MAX);
            totalFlow += result[0];
            totalCost += result[1];
        }
        return {totalFlow, totalCost};
    }
};

class OutputWriter {
private:
    ostream& out;

public:
    OutputWriter(ostream& outputStream) : out(outputStream) {}
    
    void print(Object... objects) {
        auto printHelper = [](auto&& obj) {
            out << obj;
        };
        
        auto printHelper2 = [](auto&& first, auto&&... rest) {
            out << first;
            ((out << ' ' << rest), ...);
        };
        
        if constexpr (sizeof...(objects) > 0) {
            printHelper2(objects...);
        }
    }
    
    void println(Object... objects) {
        print(objects);
        out << '\n';
    }
    
    void printf(const string& format, Object... objects) {
        // Simplified printf implementation
        // For this problem, we only need basic functionality
        out << format;
    }
    
    void close() {
        out.flush();
    }
    
    void flush() {
        out.flush();
    }
};

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& in;
    string buffer;
    size_t pos;

public:
    InputReader(istream& inputStream) : in(inputStream), pos(0) {}
    
    string next() {
        skipWhitespace();
        string result;
        while (pos < buffer.size() && !isspace(buffer[pos])) {
            result += buffer[pos++];
        }
        if (result.empty()) {
            getline(in, buffer);
            pos = 0;
            skipWhitespace();
            while (pos < buffer.size() && !isspace(buffer[pos])) {
                result += buffer[pos++];
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
    
    long nextLong() {
        return stol(next());
    }
    
    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }
    
    string nextLine() {
        getline(in, buffer);
        return buffer;
    }
    
private:
    void skipWhitespace() {
        while (pos < buffer.size() && isspace(buffer[pos])) {
            pos++;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    OutputWriter out(cout);
    int letters = 'z' - 'a' + 1;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    string s = in.next();
    vector<char> stringVec(s.begin(), s.end());
    vector<int> letCount(letters, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        letCount[stringVec[i] - 'a']++;
    }
    vector<int> b(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        b[i] = in.nextInt();
    }
    
    int source = 0;
    int charOffSet = 1;
    int pairOffSet = charOffSet + letters;
    int sinkOffSet = pairOffSet + n / 2;
    int sink = sinkOffSet;
    int vNum = sinkOffSet + 1;
    
    Graph g(vNum, source, sink);
    for (int i = 0; i < letters; ++i) {
        g.addEdge(source, charOffSet + i, letCount[i], 0);
        for (int j = 0; j < n/2; ++j) {
            char c1 = stringVec[j];
            char c2 = stringVec[n - j - 1];
            if (c1 == 'a' + i) {
                if (c1 == c2) {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -max(b[j], b[n - j - 1]));
                } else {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -b[j]);
                }
            } else {
                if (c2 == 'a' + i) {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -b[n - j - 1]);
                } else {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, 0);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n/2; ++i) {
        g.addEdge(pairOffSet + i, sink, 2, 0);
    }
    
    vector<int> ans = g.getMinCostMaxFlow();
    cout << -ans[1] << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
